sn22.76:2.4: The nine “abodes of sentient beings” (_sattāvāsā_) are listed at ([an9.24](). The “pinnacle of existence” (_bhavagga_), also mentioned in passing at [an4.75:1.3](), is the dimension of neither perception nor non-perception ([vb18:209.3](), [kv3.12:22.4]()).
sn22.76:8.1: The “ten qualities of an adept” are the eight path factors plus right knowledge and right freedom ([an10.112]()).
sn22.76:10.1: _Vikampati_ is also used in the context of the threefold conceit at [sn1.20:23.3]() = [snp4.9:8.3]() and in the verses of Mahākassapa at [thag18.1:26.4]().
